summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on reconfiguring assets. Initially, it was decided that certain 'maki' (assets) needed to be detached from current juice facilities and reassigned as standalone boxes without facility linkage for the client.

Later, a specific requirement emerged: asset boxes must be linked back to their designated facilities. This task can be completed on a phased basis.
decisions: Assets need to be detached from existing juice facilities and treated as standalone boxes.
The linking of asset boxes to specified facilities can wait until the next day.
action_items: Someone needs to detach specific assets (maki) from current juice facilities.
Assets must be linked back to their designated facilities (asset boxes to facility).
